Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Controller service managing the central repository of inventory items. Provides high-level business capabilities including item persistence, updates, deletions, case-insensitive searches, stock statistical aggregates, and CSV serialization.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Haseeb Ahmad

      public boolean updateItem(String name, int newQuantity, String newStatus)
      Updates an existing item's quantity and stock status.

    • updateItem

      public boolean updateItem(String oldName, String newName, int newQuantity, String newStatus)
      Updates an existing item's name, quantity, and status.
      Parameters:
      oldName - the current name of the item
      newName - the new name (must not conflict with another existing item)

      Returns:
      true if updated successfully; false if item not found or new name conflicts
